scenes.headline: One candle that swallows the last.
scenes.say: One candle that swallows the one before it.

scenes.headline: The bullish engulfing candle.
scenes.say: Its green body completely covers the previous red body. Sellers had control, and buyers took all of it back.

scenes.headline: Location matters more than the candle.
scenes.say: It tends to mean more at support after a pullback, like here, than in the middle of a range.
